_recorded: Derived from the secp256k1 generator point, the public key behind the BIP-173 example addresses, as CashAddr by bip_utils, an independent implementation. The legacy rows are the same key hash under Bitcoin's version bytes, which Bitcoin Cash kept.

canonical.note: the prefix is optional on the wire and always written
an all-uppercase spelling, which QR codes use, is written in lower case
a legacy address is read as written, which is also Bitcoin's spelling of the same script
a token-aware address keeps its type and pays the plain P2PKH script

invalid.note: testnet, which this build never talks to
eCash, which split from Bitcoin Cash and kept the format under its own prefix
bitcoin segwit, which Bitcoin Cash has no form of

unwatchable.note: a script hash: payable, and no key a single-key wallet derives
